ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its table. What the parts of a clip show reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.shot-content-db owns it.

rules.clip: A row is what the usable parts of one clip show (user 2026-11-10: sorting the B-roll by content): per part of its shot analysis the clip frames [from, to), the frames its 1-3 pictures were taken at and one vector of what they show (their mean, unit length); or only why the clip was not looked at.
rules.model: A row names the model its vectors come from; vectors of different models are not compared, and a clip is looked at again for another model.
rules.labels: No labels are kept: which labels a part gets is worked out from its vector when it is read (catalogs/ai/shot-labels.json), so a newsroom's own list needs no new look at the pictures.
rules.label_vectors: Beside the content a row a model keeps the vectors of the list of labels it was given and its score scale and bias, so a form sorts the B-roll by content without loading the model; made again when the list says something else (user 2026-11-10).
rules.replace: A clip looked at again replaces its row.
rules.version: A row carries the content version; a row of another version is looked at again.
